d.seg: मैं आपको तीन सौ रुपए दूंगा चार सौ रुपए दूंगा पाँच सौ रुपए दूंगा ठीक है
d.tr: I will give you 300 rupees, 400 rupees, 500 rupees, okay.
d.ctx: The user is questioning the expert's work and then offers money. The expert responds by questioning the user's intent.
d.j: The user is offering money for a service, which is a strong case for SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: क्यों तीन सौ रुपए में आप बॉडी दिखा रहे हो सबको ठीक है
d.tr: Why are you showing your body to everyone for 300 rupees, okay.
d.ctx: The user is accusing the expert of showing her body for money. The expert denies this and gets offended.
d.j: The user is making a suggestive accusation about the expert showing her body for money, which is a strong case for Explicit-Flirting.

d.seg: गंदी गंदी बातें मेरे यहाँ पर लेकर मत आओ मैं इस डोस ऐप पर डोस बनाने के लिए आई हूँ कोई रैंडी का काम करने नहीं हूँ
d.tr: Don't bring dirty talk here, I came to this app to make friends, not to do prostitute work.
d.ctx: The expert is responding to the user's accusations and refusing to engage in sexual talk. The user continues to argue.
d.j: The expert is refusing sexual talk and denying involvement in sexual services, which is a denial/about a violation.

d.seg: देखो अगर आपने व्हाट्सएप वीडियो कॉल बोला ठीक है
d.tr: Look, if you said WhatsApp video call, okay.
d.ctx: The user is arguing with the expert about whether he mentioned WhatsApp. The expert continues to defend herself.
d.j: The user is mentioning an external app (WhatsApp) while referencing a previous part of the conversation, which is a reported speech/about a violation.
